title: Home
hint: The main menu — see a real example, or jump into your own mail.

title: Inbox
hint: Every email, sorted into Discrepancy found, Needs a human, Cleared and Other mail.

title: Check a pair
hint: Upload a Shipping Instruction and a draft Bill of Lading to check them against each other.

title: Accuracy
hint: How often ClearDraft gets it right, measured on every run.

title: Sign in / your account
hint: Sign in or create an account so your mail is saved.

title: Marked as same
hint: Exact wordings you've told ClearDraft are the same, so they stop being flagged.

title: Discrepancy found
hint: Emails where the draft Bill of Lading doesn't match the Shipping Instruction.

title: Needs a human
hint: Emails ClearDraft wasn't sure enough to decide on its own.

title: Cleared
hint: Emails whose draft matched the Shipping Instruction — nothing wrong.

title: Other mail
hint: Mail that wasn't a Shipping Instruction / Bill of Lading check at all.

title: Drop .eml files
hint: Add emails saved from Gmail or Outlook as .eml files.

title: Paste an email
hint: Type or paste an email's text directly, no saved file needed.

title: Upload a dataset (.zip)
hint: Upload your company's whole inbox as one .zip file, processed live.

title: Scan a photo
hint: Scan a photo of a paper document with your camera.

title: Start
hint: Jump straight into the next case that needs you.

title: Reply to the carrier
hint: Opens the first discrepancy — then use Open in Gmail.

title: Search the inbox
hint: Search by reference, subject, sender or field.

title: Export
hint: Download a report or submission file from the inbox.

title: Discrepancy report (CSV)
hint: Download a CSV of just the discrepancies.

title: Full results (CSV)
hint: Download a CSV of every checked email.

title: Submission file (JSON)
hint: Download the JSON submission file.

title: Sample company inbox
hint: Browse the shared sample inbox of 520 example messages — not your own mail.

title: Your mail
hint: Your own emails, processed live by ClearDraft.

title: Try 6 sample emails
hint: Add 6 example emails to Your mail to try the pipeline.

title: Use a sample pair
hint: No files? Try a sample Shipping Instruction / Bill of Lading pair.

title: Sample with discrepancies
hint: A sample pair with a couple of wrong fields, on the Check a pair page.

title: Sample from the inbox
hint: A sample pair pulled from the sample inbox, on the Check a pair page.

title: Add emails
hint: Open the panel to add more of your own emails.

title: Clear your mail
hint: Delete every email you've added to Your mail.

title: Remove uploaded dataset
hint: Remove the dataset you uploaded.

title: Sign out
hint: Sign out of your account.
